title: R1 · needle tip
changes: Blade past the slot row generated, not traced: the jaw edge runs straight to the point and the outer edge sweeps in (side and robot photos).
Thickness thins smoothly from the dot to a 2.2 mm beak, with no crease.
12 mm plate; slots 3.0 x 1.35 mm (about 2.2:1); every honeycomb hole round; top-left head hole moved in so a wall stays around it.
review: The point is on the jaw corner (a tanto tip). The photos put it on the centreline, like a pencil.
The outer taper is a straight cut with a corner at the first slot. It should be a convex curve from the dot.
The plan width has a kink at the last slot. It should shrink evenly from the dot.
The ridges saw-tooth the inner edge in plan, which no photo shows.
The tip ends in a flat in thickness. The photos show a small rounded nub with a bevel on both faces.
The black nub is missing, so the yellow reads too long.
